cases.question: Compare mortgage scenarios with a 1000 lump sum and 100 extra monthly
cases.answer:
Mortgage balance $180,000.00 at 0.045, principal and interest $1,138.77 plus $661.23 escrow.
  Continue scheduled payments: 240 months, $93,304.32 lifetime interest, $1,138.77 monthly P&I. The baseline. Principal and interest only; escrow and insurance are tracked separately and are unchanged by any of these choices.
  Add $100.00 of principal every month: 211 months, $80,539.64 lifetime interest, $1,238.77 monthly P&I. The required installment does not fall. Confirm the servicer applies the extra amount to principal rather than holding it in suspense.
  Pay $1,000.00 to principal, keep the same installment: 238 months, $91,854.50 lifetime interest, $1,138.77 monthly P&I. Retires the debt sooner. The required payment is unchanged, so the monthly cash commitment does not improve.
  Pay $1,000.00 then request a recast: 241 months, $92,786.63 lifetime interest, $1,132.44 monthly P&I. A scenario until the servicer confirms availability, required curtailment, fee, eligibility and effective date. Keep the required payment unchanged until revised terms are verified. If you keep paying the former amount after a recast, that extra must be modelled explicitly rather than assumed.
Escrow, taxes and insurance are shown separately and are not affected by any of these choices. A recast requires servicer confirmation of eligibility, fee and effective date.
